params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS n, n * 7, hex(sipHash64(n)) FROM numbers({rows})

description: 3 inserts into one table on the CAS disk with GC off and the disk's expect_continue_min_bytes set to 1, so every conditional PUT (manifests, ref records) negotiates Expect: 100-continue through the proxy.
